scantool.ptxt: As the data values are standard values estimated on the basis of values obtained from the normally operating vehicles using a scan tool, use them as reference values. Even when the vehicle is in good condition, there may be cases where the checked value does not fall within each specified data range. Therefore, judgment as abnormal should not be made depending on these data alone.

Also, conditions that can be checked by the scan tool are those detected by ECM and output from ECM as commands and there may be cases where the engine or actuator is not operating (in the condition) as indicated by the scan tool. Use a timing light to check the ignition timing.

item.ptxt: If communication between SUZUKI scan tool and ECM is not possible, perform the following checks:
Check communication condition between PC and VCI using SUZUKI scan tool function.
Check DLC power circuit and ground circuit.
Check DLC cable. If necessary, check DLC cable by substituting a known-good DLC cable.
Check CAN communication circuit and connectors between DLC and central gateway control module. (Refer to “Diagnosis flow: [a]” in Troubleshooting for Lost Communication:K12C Model .)
Check CAN communication system. (“Control Module Communication Bus Off” is detected in any control module.)
Check central gateway control module power supply circuit and ground circuit.
Check ECM power circuit and ground circuit.
With the generic scan tool, only data with asterisk (*) in the following table can be read.

When checking data with engine running at idle or racing, place gear shift lever in Neutral position and apply parking brake (M/T model), place shift selector in N range and apply parking brake (auto gear shift model) or place select lever P range (CVT model) and apply parking brake fully. Also, if nothing or “no load” is indicated, turn off A/C, all electric loads, P/S and all the other switches.
Data with asterisk 1 (*1) in the table below are applicable to Non-ENG A-STOP model.
Data with asterisk 2 (*2) in the table below are applicable to ISG model.
Data with asterisk 3 (*3) in the table below are applicable to CVT model.
*4: Close hood and set ignition “OFF”, and then parameter changes to “TRUE”.

topic.title: Engine Oil Temperature (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: It is detected by oil temperature sensor.

topic.title: Fuel System (Fuel system status)
topic.ptxt: A/F ratio feedback loop status is displayed as follows.
OL: Open loop control before satisfaction of closed loop control conditions (ECT > 10 °C, IAT, TP, HO2S/system = OK).
CL: Closed loop control using oxygen sensors.
OL-DRIVE: Open loop control due to driving requirement (power-up enrichment etc.).
OL-FAULT: Open loop control due to system fault detected.
CL-FAULT: Closed loop control due to system fault detected.

topic.title: Short Term Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: Short term fuel trim value represents short term corrections to air/fuel mixture. 0 (zero) indicates no correction, a value greater than 0 indicates enrichment correction, and a value less than 0 indicates enleanment correction.

topic.title: Long Term Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: Long term fuel trim value represents long term corrections to air/fuel mixture. 0 (zero) indicates no correction, a value greater than 0 indicates enrichment correction, and a value less than 0 indicates enleanment correction.

topic.title: Total Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: Total fuel trim is calculated from short term fuel trim and long term fuel trim. This value indicates how much correction is necessary to keep the air/fuel mixture stoichiometrical.

topic.title: Inj Pulse Width (Fuel injection pulse width, msec.)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the injector drive pulse width (time) during which the injector valve stays open as commanded by ECM. (For multipoint fuel injection, the injector drive time means that of the No.1 cylinder.)

topic.title: Ignition Advance (Ignition timing advance for No.1 cylinder, ° BTDC)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the ignition timing of No.1 cylinder commanded by ECM. The actual ignition timing should be checked using a timing light.

topic.title: Calculated Load (Calculated load value, %)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates calculated engine load in percent. The load is calculated based on input signals to ECM from various engine sensors.

topic.title: Engine Speed (rpm)
topic.ptxt: The engine speed is calculated from reference pulses from the camshaft position sensor.

topic.title: Desired Idle (Desired idle speed, rpm)
topic.ptxt: The Desired Idle Speed is an ECM internal parameter which indicates idle speed requested by ECM. If the engine is not running, this number is not valid.

topic.title: MAF (Mass air flow rate, g/sec, lb/min.)
topic.ptxt: It represents total mass of air entering intake manifold which is measured by MAF sensor.

topic.title: Vehicle Speed (km/h, mph)
topic.ptxt: The vehicle speed is calculated based on pulse signals from wheel speed sensors.

topic.title: MAP (Manifold absolute pressure, kPa, mmHg, in.Hg, psi, inH2O)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the calculated manifold pressure based on MAP sensor signal.

topic.title: ECT (Engine coolant temperature, °C, °F)
topic.ptxt: It is detected by engine coolant temperature sensor.

topic.title: Intake Air Temperature (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: It is detected by intake air temperature sensor.

topic.title: Barometric Pres (Barometric pressure, kPa, mmHg, in.Hg, psi, inH2O)
topic.ptxt: This parameter represents barometric air pressure measurement and is used for altitude correction of the fuel injection rate.

topic.title: EVAP Canist Prg Duty (Evap canister purge flow duty, %)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates valve ON (valve open) time rate within a certain set cycle of EVAP canister purge valve which controls the amount of EVAP purge.

topic.title: EGR Valve Opening
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates opening rate of EGR valve which controls the amount of EGR flow.

topic.title: VVT Gap B1 IN (Variable valve timing difference between target and actual position (intake side), °)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates difference between target camshaft position (intake side) and actual camshaft position (intake side).

topic.title: VVT Gap B1 EX (Variable valve timing difference between target and actual position (exhaust side), °)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates difference between target camshaft position (exhaust side) and actual camshaft position (exhaust side).

topic.title: IAC Throttle Opening (Idle air throttle valve opening, %)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates throttle valve opening of idle air control in % (100% indicates the maximum idle air flow).

topic.title: TP Sensor 1 Volt (TP sensor (main) output voltage, V)
topic.ptxt: TP Sensor (Main) data provides throttle valve opening information in the form of voltage.

topic.title: TP Sensor 2 Volt (TP sensor (sub) output voltage, V)
topic.ptxt: TP Sensor (Sub) data provides throttle valve opening information in the form of voltage.

topic.title: APP Sensor 1 Voltage (APP sensor (main) output voltage, V)
topic.ptxt: APP Sensor (Main) data provides accelerator pedal position information in the form of voltage.

topic.title: APP Sensor 2 Voltage (APP sensor (sub) output voltage, V)
topic.ptxt: APP Sensor (Sub) data provides accelerator pedal position information in the form of voltage.

topic.title: Accelerator Position (Absolute accelerator pedal position, %)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates calculated accelerator pedal position in percent based on input from accelerator pedal position sensor.

topic.title: Throttle Position (Absolute throttle position, %)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates calculated throttle opening in percent based on input from throttle position sensor.

topic.title: Target Throttle Posi (Target throttle valve position, %)
topic.ptxt: Target Throttle Valve Position is an ECM internal parameter which indicates throttle valve position requested by ECM.

topic.title: O2S B1 S1 (HO2S-1, V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates output voltage of HO2S-1 installed on exhaust manifold (pre-TWC).

topic.title: O2S B1 S2 (HO2S-2, V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates output voltage of HO2S-2 installed on exhaust manifold (post-TWC). It is used to detect catalyst deterioration.

topic.title: Battery Voltage (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates battery voltage inputted from main relay to ECM.

topic.title: Fuel Tank Level (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates approximate fuel level in the fuel tank. The fuel level data is provided in percentage from 0 to 100%.

topic.title: A/C Pressure (A/C refrigerant absolute pressure, kPa)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates A/C refrigerant absolute pressure detected by A/C refrigerant pressure sensor.

topic.title: Generator Field Duty (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates operating rate (status of output) of the generator by field coil duty ratio.
100%: Maximum operation
0%: Minimum operation

topic.title: Battery Current (A)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates electric load value (current consumption) that is detected by electric load current sensor.

topic.title: Battery Temperature (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates battery temperature measured by battery temperature sensor.

topic.title: Brake Booster Pressure
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates differential pressure between atmospheric pressure and brake pressure.

topic.title: Generator Reg Volt (Com) (Generator regulated voltage, Command)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates commanded generator regulated voltage.

topic.title: Radiator Fan (Radiator cooling fan control relay, Low/High/Off)
topic.ptxt: Low: ON command is being output to the radiator cooling fan relay No.1.
High: ON command is being output to radiator cooling fan relays No.2 and No.3.
Off: No command is being output.

topic.title: A/C Comp Relay (A/C compressor relay, ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the A/C compressor relay.

topic.title: Fuel Pump (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: ON is displayed when ECM activates the fuel pump via the fuel pump relay switch.

topic.title: Starter Switch (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates state of starting motor relay output.
ON: Starting motor control relay is ON.
OFF: Starting motor control relay is OFF.

topic.title: A/C Switch (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: ON: Command for A/C operation is being output from ECM to HVAC.
OFF: Command for A/C operation is not being output.

topic.title: Blower Fan (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the blower speed selector.

topic.title: Brake Switch (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the brake switch.

topic.title: Electric Load (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: ON: ON signal of headlight, clearance lights or rear end door window defogger is input.
OFF: Above electric loads all turned off.

topic.title: PNP Signal (P/N or D range)
topic.ptxt: Auto gear shift model:
This parameter indicates shift selector position sent from TCM through CAN.
CVT model:
Whether the transmission range sensor is in P or N range or in other ranges is displayed. If it is in P or N range, “P/N” is displayed and if it is in other than P and N ranges, “D” is displayed.

topic.title: Clutch Switch (Declutch/Clutched)
topic.ptxt: Declutch: Clutch pedal is fully depressed.
Clutched: Clutch pedal is released.

topic.title: Cruise RES/ACC Switch (“RES / +” switch, OFF/ON)
topic.ptxt: ON: “RES / +” switch is pushed.
OFF: “RES / +” switch is released.

topic.title: Cruise SET/COAST Switch (“SET / –” switch, OFF/ON)
topic.ptxt: ON: “SET / –” switch is pushed.
OFF: “SET / –” switch is released.

topic.title: Cruise CANCEL Switch (“CANCEL” switch, OFF/ON)
topic.ptxt: ON: “CANCEL” switch is pushed.
OFF: “CANCEL” switch is released.

topic.title: Cruise ON/OFF Switch (Released/Pushed)
topic.ptxt: Pushed: “Cruise” switch is pushed.
Released: “Cruise” switch is released.

topic.title: Speed Limiter Switch (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: ON: “LIMIT” switch is pushed.
OFF: “LIMIT” switch is released.

topic.title: Speed Limiter (Inactive/Active)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the activation condition of the speed limiter system.

topic.title: Speed Limiter Main SW (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the speed limiter system.

topic.title: Fuel Cut (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: ON: Fuel injection is cut (output signal to injector is stopped).
OFF: Fuel injection is not cut.

topic.title: Closed Throttle Pos (Closed throttle position, ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter is ON when throttle valve is fully closed and OFF when the valve is not fully closed.

topic.title: O2S B1 S1 Act (HO2S-1, Active / Inactive)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the activation condition of HO2S-1.
Active: The sensor is activated.
Inactive: The sensor is being warmed up or not activated.

topic.title: O2S B1 S2 Act (HO2S-2, Active / Inactive)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the activation condition of HO2S-2.
Active: The sensor is activated.
Inactive: The sensor is being warmed up or not activated.

topic.title: ENG A-STOP (Mon) (Engine auto stop, Monitor)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the engine auto stop.

topic.title: ENG A-STOP (Com) (Engine auto stop, Command)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the engine auto stop request.

topic.title: Battery Ambient Temperature (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates battery side and ambient temperature based on battery temperature sensor.

topic.title: Battery Voltage (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates battery voltage inputted from main relay to ECM.

topic.title: Battery Current (A)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates electric load value (current consumption) detected by electric load current sensor.

topic.title: Brake Booster (Brake Booster Pressure, kPa)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates brake booster negative pressure.

topic.title: Master Cylinder Pressure (kPa)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates brake master cylinder pressure detected by master cylinder pressure sensor in ESP® control module.

topic.title: Brake Stroke (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates calculated brake pedal position in percent based on input from brake stroke sensor.

topic.title: Battery Temperature (Estimated Battery Temperature, °C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates battery inside temperature estimated by ECM.

topic.title: ISG Restart Count (Times)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates ISG operation times. 5 times of engine restarting are counted as one.

topic.title: Brake Stroke Sensor Voltage (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates brake pedal position information in voltage from brake stroke sensor.

topic.title: ISG Rotation Speed (rpm)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates ISG speed measured by ISG.

topic.title: ISG Belt Slip (Times)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates ISG belt slipping times counted by ISG.

topic.title: ISG Equipment
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates whether this vehicle is equipped with ISG.

topic.title: Transmission Type
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the type of transaxle used on vehicle.

topic.title: Neutral Switch (Neutral Position Switch, ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of Neutral position switch.

topic.title: Hood Switch1 (Hood Latch Switch 1, ON/OFF)

topic.title: Hood Switch2 (Hood Latch Switch 2, ON/OFF)

topic.title: Ignition Switch (ON/OFF)

topic.title: Starting Switch (ON/OFF)

topic.title: Half Clutch Switch (CPP No.2 Switch, ON/OFF)

topic.title: Clutch Step on Switch (CPP No.1 Switch, ON/OFF)

topic.title: Idling Stop Prohibit Switch (ENG A-STOP OFF Switch, ON/OFF)

topic.title: Charge Lamp Switch (ON/OFF)

ON: Engine is stationary.

topic.title: Brake Switch (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of brake light switch.

topic.title: ENG A-STOP Indicator Light (ON/OFF)

topic.title: SHVS Indicator Light (Regeneration) (ON/OFF)

topic.title: SHVS Indicator Light (Assist) (ON/OFF)

topic.title: ISG Control Mode (Neutral/Preparation/Drive/Power Generation/Motor Brake)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of control by ISG control module.

topic.title: Drive Limit (Enable/Drive Limit/Disable/Failure)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates restriction of ISG drive (auto start / power assist) mode affected by ISG internal heat.

topic.title: Electric Power Generation Limit (Enable/Power generation Limit/Disable/Failure)

topic.title: Stop Mode (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the engine stop.

topic.title: Starting Mode (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the engine cranking.

topic.title: Auto Stop Mode (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the engine auto stop.

topic.title: Normal Mode (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the engine running.

topic.title: DTC Condition for A-STOP Inhibition (TCM) (TRUE/FALSE)

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module Status (Regeneration) (Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) Status (Regeneration), TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for regenerating deceleration energy.

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module Status (Motor Assist) (Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) Status (Motor Assist), TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for engine power assist control.

topic.title: DTC Condition for A-STOP Inhibition (ECM) (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of DTC in engine auto stop control or ISG control detected by ECM.

topic.title: Battery Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of battery charge for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Battery Temperature Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of estimated battery temperature for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: ECT Condition (Engine Coolant Temperature Condition, TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of engine coolant temperature for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Brake Booster Condition (Brake Booster Pressure Condition, TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of brake booster negative pressure for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Brake Switch Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of brake light switch for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Seat Belt / Door Condition (Seat Belt Buckle Switch / Front Door Switch (Driver side) Condition, TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of seat belt buckle switch and front door switch (driver side) for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Hood Switch Condition (Hood Latch Switch Condition, TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of hood latch switch for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Accel Pedal Condition (Accelerator Pedal Position Condition, TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of accelerator pedal position for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Tilt Angle Condition (A-STOP) (FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter is indicated all the time without change.

topic.title: Speed History Condition (A-STOP) (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of engine auto stop permission based on vehicle running speed after the previous engine auto stop.

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module Demand Condition (Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) Demand Condition, TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of inhibition request by auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for engine auto stop control.

topic.title: ABS/ESP® Demand Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of inhibition request by ESP® control module for engine auto stop control.

topic.title: HVAC Demand Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of inhibition request by BCM for engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Deceleration A-STOP Permission (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission for execution of engine auto stop control when decelerating.

topic.title: Speed History Condition (Deceleration) (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission on vehicle running history for execution of engine auto stop control when decelerating.

topic.title: Tilt Angle Condition (Deceleration) (FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter is indicated all the time without change.

topic.title: Steering Condition (FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter is indicated all the time without change.

topic.title: ENG A-STOP OFF Switch Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of ENG A-STOP OFF switch for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Starter Inhibition Request (ABS / ESP®) (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of starting motor stop request from ESP® control module.

topic.title: ISG Belt Condition (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of ISG drive belt slip for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Assist Permit from Auxiliary power module (lithium ion battery) (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by lithium-ion battery for engine power assist control.

topic.title: Regeneration Permit Signal (TRUE/FALSE)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by ECM for deceleration energy regeneration.

topic.title: Minimum Voltage at Engine Start (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates minimum battery voltage at engine starting.

topic.title: ISG Adjusting Voltage Request Value (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates regulating voltage requested from ISG to ECM.

topic.title: Battery DOD (Battery Depth of Discharge, %)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the depth of discharge of battery.

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module Voltage (Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) Voltage, V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates voltage of lithium-ion battery in auxiliary power module.

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module Current 2 (Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) Current 2, A)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates current of relay “3P” in auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery).

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module SOC (Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) State of Charge, %)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state-of-charge of lithium-ion battery in auxiliary power module.

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module “Pb+” Terminal Voltage (Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) “Pb+” Terminal Voltage, V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates output voltage (power supply side voltage) of auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery).

topic.title: Battery Current Sensor Voltage (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates voltage value detected by electric load current sensor.

topic.title: Generator Field Coil Operation Rate (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates calculated operation rate of generator field coil based on CAN data from ECM.
